## Analysis overview

Maps numeric scores to ordered assessment categories, calculates counts and percentages by treatment and visit, fills zero-count categories, and calculates site-stratified CMH p-values.

## ADaM datasets

- `ADQSCIBC`

## Key ADaM variables

- `AVAL`: numeric CIBIC-Plus score
- `AVISIT/AVISITN`: analysis visit
- `SITEGR1`: pooled site stratum
- `EFFFL/ITTFL/ANL01FL`: selection flags
- `USUBJID`: subject identifier
- `TRTP/TRTPN`: planned treatment.
